term: guarded source-coordinate counterparts and local correspondence
definition: counterparts s w x v y requires x existing at w and y at v in the exact old doubled profile and equal source coordinates. SameLocalData matches existing rigid/doubled domains at each world uniquely in both directions, preserving concreteness and represented grounding/causing edges on matched existing endpoints. Exact relational composition includes every intermediate world and constructs an existing middle representative. This is not a global bijection of all candidates, literal identity, temporal transition, or preservation theorem for arbitrary modal formulas.
note: The source-coordinate relation is an analyst-defined structural correspondence. Existing Total/Unique/Injective/IdentityBridge semantics are reused without strengthening. Its applicability to real counterparts and all associated identity/PSR/anti-brute principles remain OPEN. See docs/notes/grounding-identity-profile.md.
